# TheatreFX

> > Professional theatrical special effects equipment including blank-firing pistols, confetti machines, and stage effects for film and live productions.

TheatreFX specializes in theatrical and film production equipment, offering blank-firing replica firearms, continuous confetti effects systems (including Funfetti Shot and Chauvet products), and CO2-powered stage effects. The company provides both product sales and customer support for professional productions.

## Key Topics

- Blank-firing pistols
- Theatrical props
- Stage firearms safety
- Confetti machines
- Continuous effects
- Funfetti Shot
- Chauvet equipment
- Large Confetti Gerb
- Small Confetti Gerb
- CO2-powered effects
- Stage effects
- Special effects equipment
- Starter pistols
- Confetti blowers
- Film production equipment

## Theatrical Firearms & Props

- [Blank Pistols](https://www.theatrefx.com/blank-pistols.html): Blank-firing replica pistols for theatrical and film productions

## Special Effects Equipment

- [Continuous Effects](https://www.theatrefx.com/continuous-confetti-effects.html): Confetti blowers and spreaders including Funfetti Shot and Chauvet products
